##### Project general facts

Shoma Bay is a luxurious residential development designed with a strong focus on comfort, convenience, and modern design. The project offers 390 condominiums, including studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, as well as 2–4 bedroom lower penthouses and penthouses.

Residents can enjoy an impressive collection of outdoor and lifestyle amenities, including a rooftop pool deck, owners’ lounge, co-working lounge, resident spa, zen garden, fitness center, yoga and Pilates studio, beauty lounge, cinema, kids club, and pet spa. The development also features a grand lobby, concierge, 24/7 security, gated parking, EV charging, smart mailroom, resident storage, and high-speed elevators for added convenience.

The residences are designed with panoramic water views, floor-to-ceiling glass doors, spacious balconies, open layouts, porcelain flooring, high ceilings, energy-efficient windows, smart home technology, and premium finishes. Kitchens feature modern Italian cabinetry, Dekton countertops and backsplashes, and premium Miele appliances, while bathrooms offer spa-inspired finishes, designer vanities, Roca mirrors, frameless rain showers, and elegant porcelain tiling.
 
##### Location description and benefits

North Bay Village is a charming waterfront community located in the heart of Miami, surrounded by Biscayne Bay. Known for its beautiful views, relaxed atmosphere, and convenient location, it offers a peaceful escape while remaining close to the city’s main attractions.

The neighborhood is made up of several small islands and features a mix of modern residential buildings, waterfront homes, restaurants, and marinas. Residents and visitors can enjoy boating, dining by the water, and scenic walks while taking in the tropical Miami lifestyle.

North Bay Village is conveniently situated between Miami and Miami Beach, providing easy access to both areas. Its combination of waterfront living, urban convenience, and a laid-back atmosphere makes it an attractive place to live, visit, or invest in property.
